Cosmetics are not subject to pre-market approval by FDA. However, pre-market approval is required for the color additives used as ingredients in cosmetics. Although we have not set limits for lead as an impurity in cosmetics, most listed color additives have specifications for lead as an impurity as part of our requirements for their safe use.
